text: Toronto and East York Community Council will introduce bills.

June 22, 2023 General Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council enacted By-laws 631-2023 to 662-2023. Confirmatory Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 663-2023. June 23, 2023 General Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council enacted By-law 664-2023. Confirmatory Bill: Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 665-2023.
